reasoning_trace.value: The paper presents an end-to-end localization framework utilizing COTS IoT devices and advanced RSSI processing techniques. The system architecture consists of two layers: Edge and Cloud. The Edge layer contains RSSI-transmitting beacons and trackable objects, while the Cloud layer is responsible for data processing and localization. The paper also discusses the use of machine learning algorithms for LoS/NLoS classification and distance estimation.

The ISAC coupling mode is achieved through the use of RSSI measurements, which are inherently embedded in wireless communication packets, to enable cost-effective and vendor-agnostic localization without the need for additional hardware.
